title: What is the best AI model? Claude Identity Verification & Fable Access Explained
description:
Big news regarding Claude AI and Fable access. Anthropic is reportedly rolling out identity verification to allow American nationals to use Fable. Is this a clever workaround for government restrictions, or just a new layer of security? We break down how you can get access and why this matters for the future of AI.

Key topics:
- Claude AI Identity Verification
- How to get access to Fable
- American government AI restrictions
- The future of Claude 3.5 and Fable
